## 2. Core Service Offerings & Disciplines

### A. Search Visibility & AI Discovery (SEO + AEO + GEO + LLM SEO)
- Enterprise Technical SEO Audits, Core Web Vitals Optimization, and Crawl Budget Management.
- Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) for Google AI Overviews, Perplexity AI, ChatGPT Search, Claude, and Apple Intelligence.
- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) ensuring accurate entity grounding, citation authority, and positive sentiment in LLM knowledge stores.
- High-Intent Keyword Targeting, E-E-A-T Content Strategy, and International/Local Multi-Location SEO.

### B. Full-Stack Website Development & AMC
- Modern Jamstack & Next.js Architecture with sub-second page loads and zero layout shift.
- WordPress & Elementor Custom Development, Migrations, and Enterprise Maintenance.
- Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), High-Fidelity UI/UX Prototyping, and Micro-Interactions.
- Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC), Security Hardening, Uptime Monitoring, and Continuous Optimization.

### C. Social Media & Performance Marketing
- Multi-Channel Paid Acquisition across Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, YouTube), Meta Ads (Instagram, Facebook), and LinkedIn Ads.
- Data-Driven Audience Segmentation, Retargeting Funnels, and Creative Testing at Scale.
- B2B Lead Generation and High-Ticket Consumer Acquisition with Verifiable ROAS.

### D. Branding, Content & Generative AI Production
- Brand Identity Design: Logo Systems, Typography Standards, Color Architectures, Brand Guidelines, and Packaging.
- Cinema-Grade Generative AI Video Production: Scripting, LoRA Prompt Engineering, Neural Synthesis, and Human Art Direction.
- 3D Virtual Product Stills, Mascot Creation, and Topical Festival Content Drops.
